date_note: The page gives only its publication day (25 November); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
title: Beazley Security says AI agents performed nearly every stage of an intrusion it investigated
org: Victim not named (case investigated by Beazley Security)
summary: Beazley Security says it investigated an intrusion in which AI agents independently performed nearly every stage of the attack, from reconnaissance to data exfiltration, according to Beinsure. The victim is not named. Beinsure reports that a weakness in a custom ASP.NET application's ViewState mechanism exposed service account information, which led to unauthorized access, persistence, lateral movement and data exfiltration.
plain: Beazley Security says it investigated an intrusion where AI agents did almost all stages of the attack, which got in through a flaw in a custom web application.
exec: Beazley Security says AI agents ran nearly every stage of an intrusion it investigated.

validation.note: Only Beinsure, relaying Beazley Security's findings, was read; Beazley Security's own report could not be found by search.

review.note: Title, summary, ViewState claim and unnamed victim checked against Beinsure
